description: UC Los Angeles — strong CA in-state applicant, RD
rationale: After the UCOP discipline data load, UCLA uses a Tier 1 CS-aware anchor. Strong CA in-state stats land just above the old 25% ceiling, while the official CS program selectivity factor keeps the estimate in the high-20s rather than letting generic in-state multipliers dominate. Range [0.10, 0.27] reflects this verified-data path.
